sources.observed_relation: # RFC: The Hounfour — Multi-Model Provider Abstraction, Cloud Deployment & Agent Distribution **Status:** Draft v4 — Implementation-Ready (blocking fixes applied) **Author:** Jani **Date:** 2026-02-08 **Revision:** v3 addressed operational items; v4 fixes five blocking correctness issues from final review **Scope:** Loa Framework → loa-finn Runtime → Arrakis Distribution **References:** [finnNFT #27](https://github.com/0xHoneyJar/loa-finn/issues/27) · [Bridgebuilder #24](https://github.com/0xHoneyJar/loa-finn/issues/24) · [OpenCode Config](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/) --- ## Preamble: Why This Document Exists > *"The difference between a junior engineer and a senior engineer is that the junior asks 'does it work?' and the senior asks 'what happens when it works at scale, for 10,000 users, at 3am, when the primary model provider is down?'"* Three systems are converging: 1. **Loa** — an AI agent-driven development framework with 8 specialized agents, currently coupled to Claude Code as both runtime and model. 2. **loa-finn** — an OpenCode-like service that gives Loa a server runtime: persistent sessions, scheduled behaviors, compound learning, and a tool sandbox.
